integrity: Proof and reproducible symbolic plus numerical comparisons are supplied; literature-priority assessment is qualified and not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite-time fourth cumulant is positive, but the exact optimally tuned correction concerns only the long-time excess-kurtosis coefficient for Poisson velocity reset to zero; finite-time optimization and arbitrary reset kernels are not established.
title: A unique optimum of non-Gaussian displacement under Poisson velocity resetting
